The compact difference set has strictly positive min sinc in open windows. Numerical checker passed 20,000 lobe-sign classification trials and finite Gram comparisons, used only as corroboration.

value.rationale: The three-band fixed-modulus phase comparator is a natural extension of connected-band Paley–Wiener concentration, with a sharp no-universal-phase cutoff at total occupied time–bandwidth 1 and infinitely many recurrent large-separation coherence windows. Three bands are the first nontrivial signed cycle and yield an exact, motivated classification, not a routine individual computation. An explicit quantitative energy deficit further characterizes phase stability; narrower than all operator-level problems but useful as a complete family theorem.
